Team — drafting two options for the customer: conservative (legal-preferred) and compromise (commercially pragmatic). Please review quickly. I also attached a marked-up PDF (Redwood_DPA_Redlines_v3.pdf) referencing section numbers for clarity.

Option A (Conservative) — absolute prohibition:
"Vendor shall not use Customer Data or any outputs derived from Customer Data to train or improve any machine learning models, or otherwise incorporate Customer Data into models or datasets that may be used to provide services to other customers or third parties. Vendor may use aggregated, non-identifiable operational metrics (e.g., request latency, error rates) to improve the performance and reliability of the Service, provided such metrics cannot be used to reconstruct or infer Customer Data."

Rationale: strongest privacy protection, likely to satisfy healthcare/legal teams, but limits Redwood's ability to use any signal that could be considered training data.

Option B (Compromise) — narrow safe harbor for non-identifiable model tuning:
"Vendor will not use Customer Data, including outputs derived from Customer Data, to train models that are made available to other Customers or third parties. Vendor may use aggregated and rigorously de-identified data for the sole purpose of improving model performance, provided that (i) data is processed under documented de-identification procedures, (ii) de-identified data cannot be re-identified using reasonable technical means, and (iii) Vendor documents the de-identification processes and provides summary attestations upon reasonable request. De-identified data excludes any Customer Data classified as PHI or other regulated personal data under applicable law."

Rationale: permits product improvements at scale while explicitly excluding PHI and requiring attestations.

Technical note for Vivek: we can offer
- A description of how prefixes / KV caching are isolated per-tenant,
- A commitment that raw customer content is not added to training corpora,
- Attestation that any model-fine-tuning for product features uses only publicly-sourced or vendor-owned datasets unless explicit written consent is obtained.

Also: I can prepare a short addendum for SCCs and an export mechanism paragraph. We should attach the current subprocessors list and our transfer addendum.

Happy to sign off on whichever option Sales chooses — I recommend Option B with the explicit PHI carve-out.
